issues.quote: I'd barely got it going when the piano started up in the salon, just as I lit my cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by my watch.
issues.fact: B3: The piano started up just as Girard lit his cigar, at 10:29 by his watch. The two events are simultaneous.
issues.misreading: "Barely got it going when" suggests the cigar was lit a moment before the piano began, so the order of the two events could be read as lighting first, then piano. The 10:29 reading itself is not affected.

issues.quote: About the money, and about nothing. He had the brandy with him. I didn't stay long.
issues.fact: B5 gives only the time Girard came back in (10:46 by his watch, with the hall clock striking eleven) and that he went up to Félix in the library. It gives no duration for the visit.
issues.misreading: "I didn't stay long" hints at a short visit length the fact sheet does not give, which a solver could use to infer a departure time from the library.
